chapter_title_en: The Weight of a Father's Silence
chapter_seo_title: The Father’s Silent Sacrifice – Li Huowang’s Painful Choice
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang faces a different kind of horror: his father’s quiet despair. A chapter of raw emotional pain and the crushing weight of love in the Dao-Twisted World.
og_title: A Spoonful of Winter Melon, A Soul Full of Pain
og_description: In a respite from monsters, Li Huowang confronts the greatest terror of all: watching his parents age under the strain of his madness.
twitter_title: The Real Monster Was Grief All Along
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s father gives him permission to live in a dream, choosing to suffer alone in reality. This chapter will break your heart.
